title: Elite: Blood Memory Wake
description: Bridge Remembers Blood: Blood Memory Wake unfolds across collapsing rune-iron spans, swinging chains, lightning-carved lanes, and oath-stones bleeding rainwater, pushing the 5-Titan Asgardian squad to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: Blood Memory Wake advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: collapsing rune-iron spans, swinging chains, lightning-carved lanes, and oath-stones bleeding rainwater

objectives.primary: Rescue marked allies while the bridge reshapes safe lanes. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.
optional: Trigger at least three Oathbound counterattacks
Hold every objective for one full enemy turn

specialRules: Remembered Impact: every third turn, old oath scars reshape safe lanes through physical bridge collapse.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
Elite Storm: lightning collapse advances one turn earlier.
Elite Banner Law: enemy buffs persist until objective action breaks the source.
victoryConditions: Rescue marked allies while the bridge reshapes safe lanes. Elite remix: complete it while a secondary storm condition is active.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
meaningfulDifferences: Boss or elite wave uses altered entry timing

tacticalProfile.rule: Recommended advantages only — any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.
